facts.text: Mum made a roast and I'm complaining about it, which is basically our tradition. Pass the gravy.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Lady Bird's words. The transcript I opened has no 'gravy' and no 'roast' anywhere, and the film uses 'Mom', not 'Mum'. Her real food lines are things like 'I'm hungry!'.
facts.fix: Lunch is the only period I like. Save me a seat, and don't tell Mum I took the brownies.

facts.text: Served at the blue house on 45th Street.
facts.why: In the transcript the three storey blue house with white shutters and an American flag is on 44th, not 45th. Danny even offers to go there to eat.
facts.fix: Served at the blue house on 44th Street.
